tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find local businesses that let AI assistants book through Belline. Matches words against the business name, trade, services and address as text; it does not search by distance. Returns each business with its services and price ranges, in its own currency. Only businesses whose owner switched this on

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: One business: what it does, hours, languages, whether it books a real diary or confirms every request itself, how long it has to answer, and its services with price ranges, callout fee and emergency surcharge where the owner set them. Prices are the owner's own figures; a range means the owner confi

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Free times for a business, from its own booking engine. Answers one of three ways: 'slots' (real free times), 'windows' (the hours the business is open, for a business with no diary of people; NOT free times, the owner confirms the visit time) or 'request' (the business confirms every request itself

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Asks a business's own receptionist (Belle) a question and returns her answer: opening hours, emergencies, call-out costs, areas served. She answers only from what the business has told her and says when she does not know, as she does for any customer. The answer carries a conversation_id that contin

tools.name: book_slot
tools.description: Books a real appointment in the business's diary, with no owner answer in between. It works only for a business whose profile has instantBooking true and for a time that get_availability returned. Returns the booking reference and a link to change or cancel it.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Sends a booking request to a business for a person. It does not book anything: the business answers (accepted, proposed another time, or declined) within the time stated in get_business_profile, and the answer is read with get_inquiry_status. A repeated request_id returns the same inquiry.

tools.name: get_inquiry_status
tools.description: Returns where an inquiry stands: received, proposed (the field 'proposed' holds the business's suggested time), accepted ('message' holds the visit time or note the business gave), declined ('message' may hold the reason), cancelled or expired. Carries no personal detail. Only accepted means the bus

tools.name: accept_proposal
tools.description: Accepts the other time the business suggested. It works only while the inquiry's status is 'proposed'. The suggested time becomes the message and the status becomes accepted.

tools.name: cancel_inquiry
tools.description: Withdraw an inquiry the person no longer wants. Works until the business has declined it or it expired; an accepted one can still be cancelled.
